items.prompt: What dollar quote is printed for integer-cent price 1005?

options.why: That treats cents as whole dollars.
The five-cent remainder needs zero padding, not a shifted decimal digit.
1005 cents is ten dollars and five cents, printed with two fractional digits.
That uses the wrong unit conversion and fractional-digit count.

items.explanation: 1005 cents is ten dollars and five cents, printed with two fractional digits.
